messages:
Elena: Clearing out extra desk gear  free Bose soundbar (works with optical + BT), plus a small IKEA floor lamp (bulb included). Pickup SF office mezzanine before Wed. Pics: https://imgur.com/abc123 :speaker:
Mateo: Interested in the soundbar! Does it have optical in and does remote work?
Elena: Optical + Bluetooth, remote works but a tiny scratch on top. I can test before you take it.
Jin: I could use the lamp if still around. My desk light broke last week.
Lila: I might grab the soundbar if Mateo can't make it. Can someone hold it until Tue afternoon?
Elena: Happy to hold until Tue 5pm for Mateo. If no show, second person in thread gets dibs.
Mateo: Sounds good. Can confirm by EOD Mon. If I can't, Lila feel free to claim.
OfficeBot: :information_source: Reminder: please label items left in common areas with owner and pickup time. Unclaimed items may be moved to the swap shelf after 72 hours.
Jin: Thanks OfficeBot. @Elena DM'ing for lamp pickup timing.
Elena: Lamp is small, has a dimmer knob. I'll leave it on the bench with a Post-it "ELENA - LAMP".
Lila: If Mateo passes I'll take the soundbar Tue evening. If not, gl Mateo  hope it works for your home setup! :thumbsup:
Mateo: Update: I can make Tue 4pm. DM'ing now to coordinate.
Jin: DM received, I can swing by Tue 3pm for the lamp.
Elena: Great! Locking in Mateo Tue 4pm for soundbar, Jin Tue 3pm for lamp. I'll update here if anything changes. Cheers :)
